meta.source: Agenzia delle Entrate — Osservatorio del Mercato Immobiliare (OMI)
meta.methodNote: Transaction-range midpoints (Compr_min/Compr_max, Loc_min/Loc_max) for "Abitazioni civili" in "NORMALE" condition, averaged across the OMI micro-zones within each comune. OMI publishes no zone population, so this is an unweighted mean across zones. OMI semester 2025H2.
